description: The agent must produce 7 distinct artifacts following strict FOSMVVM/Fluent conventions: (1) Document.swift: a final class conforming to DataModel + DocumentFields + Hashable + @unchecked Sendable, with schema='documents', @ID, @Field wrappers for title/content/case_number (snake_case key), a @Parent(key: 'author_id') satisfying the associatedtype Author (NOT using 'any AuthorFields' existential), a @Siblings(through: DocumentTag...) for the many-to-many tags relationship (NOT a [UUID] array), a 'let documentValidationMessages' property initialized FIRST in every init(). (2) DocumentTag.swift: a junction table Model with schema='document_tags', two @Parent properties (document and tag), no Fields protocol needed. (3) Document+Schema.swift: imports both Fluent AND SQLKit, migration named 'documents-initial', schema with author_id FK using .references, followed by raw SQL (casting database as? any SQLDatabase, using SQLQueryString) to add a tsvector GENERATED column and a GIN index — the tsvector must NOT be a @Field in the model. (4) DocumentTag+Schema.swift: migration named 'document_tags-initial', document_id and tag_id FK fields with .references and onDelete: .cascade, a .unique(on:) constraint on both columns. (5) Document+Seed.swift: named 'documents-seed', idempotent guard with count()==0, environment-aware switch on .debug/.test. (6) DocumentFieldsTests.swift: @Suite annotation, LocalizableTestCase conformance, private TestDocument struct with typealias Author = TestAuthor to resolve the associatedtype, a private TestAuthor struct conforming to AuthorFields. (7) database.swift modified to add Document.Initial(), DocumentTag.Initial(), and Document.Seed() inside the !isRelease block.
